+import asyncio
+import os
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import AsyncIterator, Optional
+
+import httpx
+
+
+OPENAI_AUDIO_API_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/audio/transcriptions"
+
+
+@dataclass
+class AudioChunk:
+    index: int
+    data: bytes
+
+
+async def stream_audio_chunks(source: AsyncIterator[bytes], chunk_size: int = 65536) -> AsyncIterator[AudioChunk]:
+    index = 0
+    buffer = bytearray()
+    async for item in source:
+        buffer.extend(item)
+        while len(buffer) >= chunk_size:
+            yield AudioChunk(index=index, data=bytes(buffer[:chunk_size]))
+            del buffer[:chunk_size]
+            index += 1
+    if buffer:
+        yield AudioChunk(index=index, data=bytes(buffer))
+
+
+async def transcribe_streamed_chunks(source: AsyncIterator[bytes], model: str = "gpt-4o-mini-transcribe") -> AsyncIterator[str]:
+    api_key = os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise RuntimeError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+
+    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}"}
+    async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=60.0) as client:
+        async for chunk in stream_audio_chunks(source):
+            files = {"file": (f"chunk-{chunk.index}.wav", chunk.data, "audio/wav")}
+            data = {"model": model}
+            response = await client.post(OPENAI_AUDIO_API_URL, headers=headers, data=data, files=files)
+            response.raise_for_status()
+            yield response.json().get("text", "")
+
+
+async def _example_source() -> AsyncIterator[bytes]:
+    for _ in range(3):
+        await asyncio.sleep(0)
+        yield b"\x00" * 24000
+
+
+async def main() -> None:
+    async for text in transcribe_streamed_chunks(_example_source()):
+        if text:
+            print(text)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    asyncio.run(main())

+import json
+import os
+import sys
+
+import websocket
+
+
+ASSEMBLYAI_WS_URL = "wss://api.assemblyai.com/v2/realtime/ws"
+
+
+def build_url(language_code: str, punctuate: bool) -> str:
+    return f"{ASSEMBLYAI_WS_URL}?sample_rate=16000&punctuate={'true' if punctuate else 'false'}&language_code={language_code}"
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    api_key = os.environ.get("ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise RuntimeError("ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY is required")
+
+    language_code = os.environ.get("ASSEMBLYAI_LANGUAGE_CODE", "en_us")
+    punctuate = os.environ.get("ASSEMBLYAI_PUNCTUATE", "true").lower() in {"1", "true", "yes", "on"}
+
+    ws = websocket.create_connection(build_url(language_code, punctuate), header=[f"Authorization: {api_key}"])
+
+    try:
+        while True:
+            message = ws.recv()
+            if not message:
+                continue
+            data = json.loads(message)
+            if data.get("message_type") == "FinalTranscript":
+                transcript = data.get("text", "")
+                if transcript:
+                    sys.stdout.write(transcript + "\n")
+                    sys.stdout.flush()
+            elif data.get("message_type") == "SessionBegins":
+                continue
+    finally:
+        ws.close()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
